text_block_list.text:
One day,
a corner of the gym was radiating intense heat.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...! Come on, glutes!
Just a little moreee...!
Mejiro Ryan is pushing her muscles to the absolute limit... Her sheer drive makes you want to cheer her on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, ah!
I'm sorry, were we being too loud?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Even though I added more reps than yesterday, I'm just so happy my muscles kept up.
choice_data_list: Let's push ourselves to the limit!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I see. Even though I call it achieving my goal,
I was just arbitrarily setting my own finish line...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Maybe our muscles are begging to push a bit harder!
Alright, let's give it one more push!

Afterward, Mejiro Ryan kept squatting
all the way to her absolute limit...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Phew, that was an amazing burn! Look, my quadriceps are practically smiling with joy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to you telling me to push to my limits.
Otherwise, I would've finished without giving it my all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: All right, next we're gonna push these biceps to the max, let's gooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I like muscle training because it never lies to you.
If you take it seriously, the results are guaranteed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I did more today than yesterday...
And tomorrow, even more! Feeling that growth is great.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, listen to me rambling on!
Alright, time for some shoulder presses next!
